Production fine-pixel game sprite atlas for Tomade. Image 1 is the APPROVED office desk STYLE MASTER; image 2 is the APPROVED outdoor pixel-art STYLE MASTER. Redraw the requested office objects with the same fine coherent pixel modeling, warm oak, natural source color gradations built from small discrete pixels, crisp thin closed dark edges, and readable light/shadow. Keep silhouettes precise; corner steps neither huge blocks nor noisy tiny jaggies. Think 0.54 world-units per native pixel and a dark 2-native-pixel contour. Each object must be COMPLETE and ISOLATED. Orthogonal slightly elevated RPG view, horizontal front edges, no isometric tilt. Tiny orderly wood grain, restrained highlights, no blur, no painterly speckles, no glossy 3D. Preserve subtle original color tones; do not posterize to a very small palette. PERFECTLY SOLID MAGENTA RGB(255,0,255) outside all objects and through all openings. No floor, cast shadows, text, grid lines, numbers, borders, labels or neighboring furniture attached. Strict equal-cell layout; keep entire objects well within their cells, 15% blank padding on every side. Natural object aspect ratios inside square cells, not stretched to fill a square. No overlaps or cell crossings. High quality detailed pixel art, not flat vector shapes. ONE 3-column by 3-row atlas, exactly 9 equal square cells.
